title: Flow Minimap Finer Edges
description: On minimap LOD the edges should be finer and not so thick.
summary: Minimap LOD edges now use a 1px screen stroke instead of the default 2px. Added `DagDrawLod::edge_stroke_screen_px` and `DAG_EDGE_STROKE_MINIMAP_SCREEN_PX`; `paint_scene` picks stroke width from the active LOD tier.
